data.long_description:
Experience breathtaking views of the golf course right from the comfort of your exquisite home. Let the verdant landscapes bring you closer to nature as you enjoy peaceful evening walks through the tranquil neighborhood with your loved ones.

Welcome to Golf Place II at Dubai Hills Estate.

Property Highlights:

-6 Bedrooms
-7 Bathrooms
-3 Parking Space 
-13,249.94 Sq. ft 
-Maid’s Room
-Private Gym
-Roof Terrace 
-Full Golf Views 
-Handover Q2 2025

Strategically located with easy access to Al Marabea Road, Golf Place II is only minutes away from Downtown Dubai and its key business, retail, and entertainment destinations. The community features expansive green spaces, diverse family and sports amenities, the Dubai Hills Mall, and an iconic clubhouse, all designed to enrich the lifestyle of its residents.

The luxurious villas at Golf Place II are the epitome of modern living, offering a perfect blend of elegance and comfort. With a championship 18-hole golf course at your doorstep, these homes are ideal for those seeking a lifestyle of family bonding and sporting excellence.

The Dubai Hills Golf Club spans an impressive 1.2 million sqm, equivalent to 63 football fields, offering meticulously manicured fairways. Set against the stunning Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai skyline, the 18-hole course promises to inspire your best performance.

Elevate your lifestyle with world-class amenities at Golf Place II. Boost your fitness routine with state-of-the-art sports facilities designed to enhance every workout experience.

Amenities Include:

Dubai Hills Mall
Urban Beach
Fitness Amenities
Kids' Play Area
Dubai Hills Park
